relationship: Advancing a network scenario connects simultaneous Ethernet transmissions to carrier sensing, collision handling and retransmission.

learnerLoop.action: Choose a scenario and step or play the transmission.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Signals move between stations and the protocol phase advances.
learnerLoop.evidence: The network animation, narration and event checkpoints show the current event.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Predict whether the medium is clear, colliding or ready for a later transmission.

invariants: The narration and displayed phase describe the same scenario state.
Collision behaviour follows the selected simultaneous-send scenario.
safeAdaptations: Change station stories, pacing or prompts while preserving the sequence of medium access and collision evidence.

task.description: Scenario choice and the current medium-access situation.
task.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

medium.description: Three station states, shared cable, travelling frame, collision and jam signals.
medium.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

evidence.description: Current local decision and carrier-sense/collision rule in the right evidence column.
evidence.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

progress.description: Compact event checkpoints, manual Next, Play/Pause/Replay and reset.
progress.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

event.domain: Finite scripted sequence; six single-send or nine collision states.

backoff.description: Collision participants wait different slot counts before retry.
backoff.domain: Random 0 or 1 slot, forced different for the two senders.
backoff.output: Backoff station thought and retry order.

modes.scenarios: A sends to C, B sends to C, or A and C collide. Changing scenario starts playback; Reset returns to its first event without playback.
modes.support: No Working or exam toggle. Next and playback traverse identical event states.

dependencies: Next is disabled while playing and at the final event.
Only the collision scenario introduces jam and random backoff.
implementation.completion: The final frame marks delivery complete; Replay or Reset starts the selected scenario again.
limitations: Scripted educational timing, not a physical Ethernet performance simulator.
